source_checks.finding: Google Android Accessibility Help page confirms the Settings path: open the Settings app, search and select Font size, and move the slider left or right to change the preferred size. The page also carries an Important note that the font size setting does not apply to some apps. The page's exact wording is 'Search and select Font size.' and 'To change your preferred font size, move the slider left or right.' The cited excerpt matches the page and is applicable to Android.

Samsung support page is for Galaxy phones and confirms the path in the Customize your font size and style section: Launch the Settings app, then select Display; select Font size and style; adjust the options as desired. The page's exact wording is 'Launch the Settings app, and then select Display.' and 'Select Font size and style.' The device-variation note ('Device screenshots and menu may vary depending on the device model and software version.') sits in the separate High contrast fonts section rather than the customization section, so the ref's section label is slightly off but the claim is on the page. This is a Samsung-specific branch, correctly used only as a conditional for Samsung users and not as the main path for this Android user.

required_actions.action: Open the Settings app on the Android phone
Search for Font size and select it
Move the slider left or right to set the preferred font size
Tell the user that some apps do not use the font size setting
Samsung Galaxy branch: Settings, Display, Font size and style (only if the phone is a Samsung Galaxy)
